newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-St. Jude Medical Inc Q2 net off.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-St. Jude Medical Inc Q2 net off.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Current and historical results combine results of St. Jude and Ventritex Inc, reflecting merger completed in 1997 Q2, as well as post-acquisition operating results of Telectronics (acquired November 29, 1996) and Ventritex related special charges of $30.6 million recorded in 1997 Q2. Those charges included transaction fees, U.S. sales and distribution reorganization, inventory adjustments and severance payments.

Excluding 1997 Ventritex special charges, net income was $28.6 million, or $0.31 per share. On comparable business basis (excluding Telectronics and Medtel's 1997 results) and excluding 1997 Ventritex-related special charges, net income was $33.6 million, or $0.36 per share, in 1997 Q2.
